episodes.synopsis: Uchimura is a regular office worker who did his best to find a job at a company and worked hard, but was constantly overlooked by his superiors. Just when his superiors decided to shunt him off to another dead-end branch, Uchimura is abruptly summoned by the Demon King of another world to work as one of his four generals.
episodes.title: Tips on How to Pass the Entrance Exam in Another World

episodes.synopsis: Hired as an Elite General, Dennosuke’s first task is to negotiate a merger with the leader of the resource starved Ogre Tribe. Despite their suffering and the Ogre leader's stubbornness, Dennosuke works to find a way forward for the Demon lord's army.
episodes.title: The Art of Negotiation in Captivating a Stubborn Tribal Chief

episodes.synopsis: Dennosuke now has the help of Olulu, the daughter of the leader of the ogre clan. This fact greatly annoys Ulmandra, who tries to get close to our protagonist with little success.
episodes.title: Now I Understand! Elite General Communication

episodes.synopsis: The Dark Lord gives Dennosuke a new task: to research the magical arts so that everyone can use magic even without the necessary power. And this time, he will have the help of the elusive Sylphid.
episodes.title: Breakthroughs Happen Even With Magic!

episodes.synopsis: Having done so much under the Overlord's direct orders, Dennosuke now feels he must step up his game by becoming proactive. He decides to make a bold move by researching the marketplace with Ulmandra, hoping to find a hint to make the army even greater.
episodes.title: The Best Way to Enjoy a Stroll Through the Marketplace in Another World

episodes.synopsis: Uchimura is off to go on his first business trip to the Golden Kingdom, where he must negotiate a trade with the formidable Rampage King. Will his previous experiences help him get the deal he needs to solve the current crisis?
episodes.title: The Art of Managing People

episodes.synopsis: Rampage King suddenly no longer wants to trade with the Demon Army saying he could get it elsewhere. Uchimura must now find out why this is happening.
episodes.title: Conditions to Become a First-class Merchant

episodes.synopsis: The guild is monopolizing the gim to get rich! Will Uchimura and Sylphid be able to find the proof they need?
episodes.title: Bring Down the Scalpel of Justice to the Corrupt Organization!

episodes.synopsis: Uchimura is in trouble as their plans get sabotaged by a spy. Will his next move expose the evil merchant?
episodes.title: The Sins and Punishments of an Evil Merchant.

episodes.synopsis: Uchimura's next challenge is to deal with a calamity as well as deal with a racial conflict within the army.
episodes.title: Sword and Shield

episodes.synopsis: With Ulmandra down, Uchimura starts to lose himself as he hastily tries to devise a plan against the wyverns.
episodes.title: A Battle Without Heroes.

episodes.synopsis: Uchimura was asked to become the next King by the Demon Overlord?! Will he overcome his fears?
episodes.title: How to Find Your Way of Life
